system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 33. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (22 seconds, code score 0.90) ---
[b00] MAID (desperate, denying): "No!"
[b01] LORD (low, menacing): "Think carefully."
[b02] LORD (ruthless): "Your brother is still a pauper."
[b03] LORD (threatening): "One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise."
[b04] ACTION: The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.
[b05] MAID (begging, heartbroken): "Please, my Lord... he is only seven!"
[b06] LORD (cold, unwavering): "Then help him."
[b07] MAID (crying, shattered): "What do you want me to say?!"

--- WINDOW 1 (24 seconds, code score 0.85) ---
[b00] MAID (wailing, tormented): "I never said she was a witch!"
[b01] LORD (chillingly detached): "You do not need to."
[b02] LORD (chillingly detached): "I have already written the story for you."
[b03] MAID (sobbing): "She saved my brother..."
[b04] LORD (inexorable): "And now... you will save your brother."
[b05] ACTION: The maid's knees buckle completely. She collapses forward onto the polished dark wood floor, groveling in total despair.
[b06] MAID (weeping, broken): "I am sorry, Lady Juliana..."
[b07] LORD (cold, merciless): "Save your tears for the trial."

--- WINDOW 2 (27 seconds, code score 0.84) ---
[b00] LORD (relentless): "You saw her use a forbidden book."
[b01] LORD (condemning): "You heard words you could not understand."
[b02] LORD (deadly, resolute): "That is witchcraft."
[b03] MAID (crying out, desperate): "No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!"
[b04] LORD (cold, final): "That will be your testimony."
[b05] MAID (gasping, shocked): "My testimony?!"
[b06] LORD (unyielding): "Before the magistrate."
[b07] MAID (wailing, tormented): "I never said she was a witch!"

--- WINDOW 3 (26 seconds, code score 0.79) ---
[b00] LORD (accusatory): "Did she use her mother's book?"
[b01] MAID (quietly weeping): "Yes."
[b02] LORD (insistent, cornering): "Did she prepare things no physician had prescribed?"
[b03] MAID (choked sob): "Yes."
[b04] LORD (sly, sinister): "And did she perform anything unusual?"
[b05] MAID (desperate, denying): "No!"
[b06] LORD (low, menacing): "Think carefully."
[b07] LORD (ruthless): "Your brother is still a pauper."

Pick the single best promo.
